tools.name: wb_list_models
tools.description: List the WorkBuddy chat models that are safe to call (official public catalog only), each with its credit multiplier (e.g. x0.79, already including time-limited discounts), context window and reasoning efforts. Read-only; costs nothing. Pass all=true to also list models that are disabled, internal routing aliases, media/code models or delisted ones — those are not callable through this bridge while worlds.workbuddy.safeOnly is on.

summary.zh: 列出 WorkBuddy 公开对话模型（安全清单）及各自的积分倍率、上下文与推理档；all=true 时附上被排除的项与原因。
summary.en: Lists the safe WorkBuddy chat models with multiplier, context and reasoning efforts; all=true also lists excluded ones with reasons.

all.description: Also list models outside the safe list (shown with their risk reason).

tools.name: wb_select_model
tools.description: Select which WorkBuddy model wb_chat should use by default. The id must come from wb_list_models. Persists across restarts.

summary.zh: 选择 wb_chat 默认使用的 WorkBuddy 模型，选择会持久保存。
summary.en: Selects the default WorkBuddy model for wb_chat; the choice persists across restarts.

tools.name: wb_chat
tools.description: Ask the selected WorkBuddy model a single-turn question and return its answer. This spends the user's own WorkBuddy credits at the model's multiplier; keep prompts concise. Use the model parameter only to override the selected model for one call. Requires the WorkBuddy desktop app to be running.

summary.zh: 向当前选中的 WorkBuddy 模型发一句单轮提问并取回答，会消耗用户自己的 WorkBuddy 积分。
summary.en: Asks the selected WorkBuddy model a single-turn question; spends the user's own WorkBuddy credits.

model.description: Optional model id overriding the selected one for this call.

system.description: Optional system prompt for this call.

tools.name: wb_credits
tools.description: Show the remaining WorkBuddy credit balance of the signed-in account (read-only). Requires the WorkBuddy desktop app to be running.

summary.zh: 读取当前 WorkBuddy 账号的剩余积分与各积分包的已用/剩余（只读）。
summary.en: Shows remaining WorkBuddy credits and per-package usage (read-only).

description.zh: World 挂载完成，报告登录态与目录概况。
description.en: The World was mounted; reports sign-in and catalog status.

envPrompt:
## WorkBuddy bridge

This machine has a signed-in WorkBuddy desktop app bridged in (signed in: {{workbuddy.authed}}).
The model catalog holds {{workbuddy.catalogSize}} models. The currently selected model is `{{workbuddy.model}}` with default credit multiplier {{workbuddy.multiplier}}.
WorkBuddy desktop main process: {{workbuddy.process}}.
Spent today through the bridge: {{workbuddy.todayCredit}} credits / {{workbuddy.todayTokens}} tokens (locally recorded).
The multiplier above is the model's own price plus any time-limited price change this bridge can verify at the moment (including free windows). An offer that only shows a badge may not change the price; `wb_list_models` marks which offers are active and their hours.

- Use `wb_list_models` to see every model with its multiplier before choosing; prefer low-multiplier models for casual tasks.
- Safe-list gate: {{workbuddy.safeOnly}}. When it is `on`, only the models WorkBuddy publishes as public chat models are callable — `disabled` entries, internal routing aliases (`auto`, `fast-model`, `balanced-model`, `deep-model`), media/code models and delisted ones are refused. Do not try to work around a refusal; tell the user why and offer a safe model instead. `wb_list_models` with `all=true` shows the refused ones with reasons.
- Use `wb_select_model` when the user asks to switch the WorkBuddy model.
- `wb_chat` only works while the WorkBuddy desktop main process is running; otherwise it returns「未检测到 WorkBuddy 主进程」. Every call spends the user's own credits at that model's multiplier. Call it when the user asks for WorkBuddy or when a WorkBuddy model would clearly help; do not route every turn through it.
- `wb_credits` is read-only and costs nothing (also requires the desktop process).
